description: Dependency updates for WingChunRoots (plan §3.2): exact versions, a waiting period for new releases, digest-pinned images and actions, and security fixes at any time.

prBodyNotes: If this release is younger than 1 day, pnpm's strict minimumReleaseAge rejects it and `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` fails: add the exact fixed versions to `minimumReleaseAgeExclude` in `pnpm-workspace.yaml` in this PR (docs/adr/0001-stack.md, Renovate; plan §3.2). Never weaken the setting itself.

packageRules.description: Docker images and GitHub Actions stay pinned by digest; digest refreshes follow the weekly schedule.
PostgreSQL/PostGIS major and minor upgrades are separate goals (plan §9); only digest refreshes here.
Next.js and React move together; the weekly security window groups their patch releases (plan §3.2).
engines.node is the .nvmrc floor (>=26.12.1, a security release) and changes only with .nvmrc.
The Node.js runtime itself is upgraded as a separate goal (plan §9).
